The proposed hypothesis is a single-variable feature, not an interaction, so it sidesteps the interaction failure only in form. It doesn't address the weak IC. On coverage, it uses an expanding-history standardization and a year-over-year change, which still require long history, so coverage would likely stay limited. There is no regime conditioning. On word count, the hypothesis is about 35 words, and the limit isn't stated. The report says the earlier one exceeded it by two words, and the limit is unknown, so this can't be verified.

The hypothesis doesn't explicitly avoid any of the failures. It doesn't address coverage, regime dependence, or the word limit in a demonstrable way.
